name: Question 1
problem:
Consider the following first-order linear ODE for the function $y=y(x):$

$$
\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x}+\frac{1}{x}\cdot y={e}^{x},\,x>0
$$

Write the equation in the form $\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(yI(x))=I(x)Q(x),$ where $I(x)$ is an integrating factor.

Question 1
?

Consider the following first-order linear ODE for the function y=y(x): dydx+1x⋅y=ex,x>0 Write the equation in the form ddx(yI(x))=I(x)Q(x), where I(x) is an integrating factor.

a
ddx(yx2)=x2ex
b
ddx(yex)=exex
c
ddx(yln⁡x)=ln⁡x⋅ex
d
ddx(ye−x)=e−xex
e
ddx(yx)=xex
